def find_kth_sequence(n, k):
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    dp = [0] * n
    dp[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n):
        dp[i] = sum(dp[(i - j) % n] for j in range(1, n)) % MOD
    
    prefix_sum = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        prefix_sum[i] = (prefix_sum[i - 1] + dp[i]) % MOD
    
    result = []
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        for j in range(1, n):
            if (prefix_sum[(i - 1) % n] - prefix_sum[(i - j) % n] + MOD) % MOD >= k:
                result.append(j)
                k -= (prefix_sum[(i - 1) % n] - prefix_sum[(i - j) % n] + MOD) % MOD
                break
    
    return result[::-1]
